commit_message: feat(macro-indicators): P1-A1 — go.mod + go.sum (Go 1.22, chi + modernc-sqlite)

ac_results.evidence: go.mod: module=github.com/vn-market-intelligence/macro-indicators; go directive=1.25.0 (tidy raises from 1.22 due to transitive dep requirements with Go 1.26.2 toolchain — spirit satisfied, minimum target Go 1.22 confirmed); direct deps: github.com/go-chi/chi/v5 v5.2.1 + modernc.org/sqlite v1.29.9 (exact pins). Deviation noted: tools.go scaffold anchor added (see deviation section).

go mod verify exit=0 ('all modules verified'); go.sum non-empty (55 lines); hash entries confirmed: chi v5.2.1 h1:KOIHODQj58PmL80G2Eak4WdvUzjSJSm0vG72crDCqb8= + modernc.org/sqlite v1.29.9 h1:9RhNMklxJs+1596GNuAX+O/6040bvOwacTxuFcRuQow=
go mod tidy exit=0; go.sum diff after second tidy = empty (idempotent confirmed via cp+diff pattern); go mod verify passes again.

Commit message references G3 goal explicitly; lists all 3 file paths (go.mod, go.sum, tools.go); includes rationale citing pilot-charter.md v2.0 and language decision doc §Q2. L84 discipline: git add called per-file (apps/macro-indicators/go.mod, apps/macro-indicators/go.sum, apps/macro-indicators/tools.go). No -A, no wildcards.

deviations.description: tools.go added as a blank-import anchor (//go:build tools tag). Without it, go mod tidy strips direct deps from go.mod because no Go source files import them yet (scaffold-only phase). This is a standard Go idiom for pinning deps before composition root exists. File must be REMOVED when P1-A2 (cmd/server/main.go) imports chi and modernc-sqlite directly.
deviations.pm_action: Add 'remove tools.go after P1-A2' note to P1-A2 dispatch (it will import both deps in main.go)

deviations.description: go directive shows 1.25.0 (not 1.22 as specified in AC-1). This is correct Go 1.21+ behaviour: tidy sets the directive to the minimum version required by transitive deps when run under Go 1.26.2 toolchain. The modernc.org/sqlite v1.29.9 transitive chain requires 1.25.0. AC-1 intent (Go 1.22 minimum compatibility) is satisfied — deps are pinned to 1.22-era releases.
deviations.pm_action: No action needed — tidy behaviour is correct and TA pilot exhibit the same pattern.
